notes.title: JBRMK v1.04
notes.content:
- Resource management (Large update. Same files, just modified.)
- Added Dodge action/button. (Dodge button for controller will need to be reset if JBRMK was previously played.)
- Added another light punch and stronger punch while running. (Abilities will evolve during future events).
- Modified punch color indicators during combat.
- Added Combat: Cursor Sensitivity settings for mouse and controller.
- Added visible marker to target lock-on while fighting multiple enemies.
- Modified Graphics menu.
- Added Brightness, Contrast and Saturation to settings, with 'Hide Background' toggle, during gameplay.
- Added controller Rumble (Heptic System) to combat, hovering over highlighted objects and to certain events.
- Translation tweaks.

notes.title: JBRMK v1.03
notes.content:
- Upgraded to [i]infinite[/i] automatic controller to mouse/keyboard swapping during gameplay, without opening settings menu. Up from once per scene. Controller cursor (right analog), and any keyboard press are the triggers. Menu interfaces already swap automatically.
- Enabled non-immersion breaking loading screen
- Resource management

notes.title: Welcome! Johnny Boy: Red Moon's Kiss - Store Page is Now Live!
notes.content:
Hello and welcome!

I thought it fitting to add our first bit of news. If you're here, then I'm sure you're already well informed on the first part: The JBRMK Store Page is now live!

Even though this is just the beginning, this day has been a long time coming. Unless disaster strikes, the Official, planned release date for Johnny Boy: Red Moon's Kiss - Episode 1, is January 31, 2022. Episodes 2 and 3 (DLC 1), Episodes 4 and 5 (DLC 2), and Episode 6 (DLC 3), will all release some time after, possibly 6+ months apart.

A huge initial release was not planned for this project, due to the fact that this is my first ever release. I will iron out any issues and improve on whatever is required. After JBRMK E1 releases, I will be able to advertise in a much more streamlined manner, in regards to Episodes 2, 3, 4, 5 and 6. Once a quality game is up and running, many doors will open.

In the end, JBRMK will become a single, complete game with all 6 Episodes. After this milestone is completed, JBRMK will be submitted to consoles for review. Until then, let me know how you're enjoying the released content for JBRMK!
